properties.title: UTM zone 16 — 2025 field boundaries
properties.description: Predicted field boundaries falling in UTM zone 16 for 2025: 2,165,247 parcels, 207,019 km² of field area, in one cloud-native GeoParquet file. Part of [Fields of the World](https://fieldsofthe.world) — agricultural field boundaries delineated from Sentinel-2 imagery. Columns: id, collection, geometry, bbox, metrics:area, metrics:perimeter, ftw:tile, ftw:field_prob, ftw:boundary_prob, ftw:frac_nodata_1q, ftw:frac_nodata_3q, ftw:frac_water, ftw:frac_crops_ever, ftw:slope_mean, ftw:frac_slope_gt30, ftw:elev_mean, ftw:patch_sat_mean, ftw:patch_sat_max, ftw:patch_pb_mean, ftw:touches_window_edge — see `table:columns` for definitions.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: Parcel identifier, unique per collection ([fiboa 0.3.0](https://fiboa.org/specification/v0.3.0/schema.yaml)).

table:columns.name: collection
table:columns.description: The vecorel collection the parcel belongs to (constant per year, e.g. `ftw-s2-2025`).

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Parcel footprint (WKB Polygon/MultiPolygon, WGS 84).

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the parcel (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax).

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the parcel in square meters ([vecorel 0.1.0](https://vecorel.org/specification/v0.1.0/schema.yaml) geometry-metrics).

table:columns.name: metrics:perimeter
table:columns.description: Perimeter of the parcel in meters ([vecorel 0.1.0](https://vecorel.org/specification/v0.1.0/schema.yaml) geometry-metrics).

table:columns.name: ftw:tile
table:columns.description: Sentinel-2 MGRS tile the parcel was extracted from.

table:columns.name: ftw:field_prob
table:columns.description: Mean model field probability inside the parcel.

table:columns.name: ftw:boundary_prob
table:columns.description: Mean model boundary probability inside the parcel.

table:columns.name: ftw:frac_nodata_1q
table:columns.description: Fraction of the parcel with nodata in >= 1 of the 4 quarterly mosaics.

table:columns.name: ftw:frac_nodata_3q
table:columns.description: Fraction with nodata in >= 3 quarterly mosaics.

table:columns.name: ftw:frac_water
table:columns.description: Fraction classed water in io-lulc 2024 (30 m).

table:columns.name: ftw:frac_crops_ever
table:columns.description: Fraction classed crops in io-lulc 2017, 2020 or 2024.

table:columns.name: ftw:slope_mean
table:columns.description: Mean slope, degrees (Copernicus 30 m DEM).

table:columns.name: ftw:frac_slope_gt30
table:columns.description: Fraction with slope > 30 degrees.

table:columns.name: ftw:elev_mean
table:columns.description: Mean elevation, m.

table:columns.name: ftw:patch_sat_mean
table:columns.description: Mean over covering inference patches of the fraction of pixels with field prob >= 0.9 (flipped-patch detector).

table:columns.name: ftw:patch_sat_max
table:columns.description: Max over covering inference patches of that fraction.

table:columns.name: ftw:patch_pb_mean
table:columns.description: Mean boundary probability over the covering inference patches.

table:columns.name: ftw:touches_window_edge
table:columns.description: Parcel touched a processing window edge (possible truncation).
